source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of classes and objects (PDF 57).

blocks.text: Class cheezein banane ka saancha (template) hai, aur object us saanche se bani asal cheez. Farz karein aap khilona gaari banana chahte hain. Pehle aap ko blueprint (naqsha) chahiye jo bataye ke gaari kaisi dikhe aur kaise kaam kare. Is blueprint mein yeh details hoti hain:

items: Material ki type (kis cheez se bani)

blocks.text: Blueprint khud gaari nahi; yeh sirf ek plan hai, aur yahi class hai.

Isi blueprint se aap kai gaariyan bana sakte hain. Har gaari ki apni characteristics (khoobiyan) hongi, jaise alag rang ya size. Yahi asal objects hain jin se aap khel sakte hain. Har object class ka instance (us se bani ek copy) hai: woh blueprint ke mutabiq banta hai magar us ki apni values hoti hain.

blocks.prompt: Class aur object mein farq samjhaiye (short question 8).
blocks.explanation: Class aisa plan hai jo batata hai ke us ke objects ke kaunse attributes aur methods honge; object us plan se bana ek asal instance hai jis ki apni values hain: ToyCar class hai, car1 (laal, chhoti, 4 pahiye) object hai.

items: Class: blueprint (naqsha); object: us se bani asal cheez (instance).
